Design scope

What the architecture covers

Start with the operational backbone, then shape the guest experience around it. Kitchens, ventilation, seating, service routes and facade are resolved as one building.

01Kitchen and back of houseSet the kitchen, storage, washing and staff areas around the operating model.
02Ventilation routesReserve practical paths for exhaust, fresh air and heat management.
03Seating and circulationBalance guest capacity with comfortable movement and service flow.
04Health and safety planningCoordinate wash areas, exits and hygienic separation early.
05Facade and arrivalMake the entrance visible and consistent with the concept and site.
06Building servicesPlan power, gas, plumbing, drainage, cooling and fire requirements.

Eight-step process

From brief to buildable drawings

Each stage closes the important decisions before the next one begins.

01

Brief and site analysis

Confirm the project brief, review the site and record the constraints that shape the design.

02

Concept planning

Test layout, zoning, access and movement before the architectural form is fixed.

03

Form and 3D studies

Develop the exterior character and review key views, proportions and materials.

04

Design development

Resolve dimensions, openings, levels, materials and the key technical decisions.

05

Working drawings

Prepare coordinated plans, sections, elevations and the agreed construction details.

06

Authority submission

Develop the required architectural set around the relevant approval process.

07

Kitchen and MEP specialists

Align equipment, exhaust, gas, drainage, power and fire requirements with the building.

08

Final handover

Issue the agreed drawing package for pricing, coordination and construction.

Architecture fees

A clear range before the proposal

The fee covers architectural design and drawings. Construction, interior design and fit-out are separate unless they are added to the brief.

IncludedConcept planning, kitchen and service zoning, facade studies, drawings and coordination.
Final feeThis range suits focused restaurant and cafe building design. Larger or multi-level projects are quoted separately.
Separate costsGovernment charges, surveys and third-party specialist fees are confirmed separately where needed.
Indicative design feePKR 500K–1.5M
